snippet.title: Go Long! – Official Trailer | Goofy 3v3 Catching Sport on Steam
snippet.description:
Wishlist Go Long! on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5356650/

Longball is a goofy, floppy 3v3 catching sport. Throw Long Bombs, dive for trick catches and mess with rivals using powers in six wild stadiums, then pelt a giant boss at halftime. Play online with friends or against bots, or take your crew through the League.

• Online 3v3, or play offline against bots
• 14 powers: trick balls, sabotage and helpers
• Six stadiums, each with its own twist
• A giant boss crashes every halftime
• Party up with friends, or host a private match from 1v1 to 4v4
• Level up to 50 and unlock hats, ball colours and trails
• Playable in 31 languages

Coming soon to Steam.

Made by Comet Goblin, an independent game studio making playful games and curious worlds: https://cometgoblin.com

#GoLong #IndieGame #Steam
